create_checkpointer: create a Checkpointer to periodically save TensorFlow model checkpoints to a directory
restore_checkpoint: restore the most recent checkpoint using the Checkpointer restore method
create_snapshotter: create a Snapshotter to save permanent SavedModel snapshots of Sonnet modules
wrap_with_checkpointing_runner: wrap a Learner with CheckpointingRunner to auto-checkpoint on each step
make_snapshot: create a snapshottable wrapper around a Sonnet module using make_snapshot
